title: Harden review-freeze helper invocation and CI cancellation ergonomics
outcome: Round-4 review identified Low-level tooling follow-ups: the helper's import.meta.url main-module check silently exits successfully when invoked through a symlink, and the dedicated PR workflow lacks a concurrency group to cancel superseded runs. Preserve the five-field integrity contract while making invocation behavior explicit and CI resource use bounded.
acceptance: Direct and symlinked helper invocations either emit the same five fields or fail explicitly; regression coverage pins the behavior; review-freeze CI cancels superseded runs per branch/PR without dropping the required gate.
